description:
By default, select all action generators.  When specified, limit selection to specified conditions.

monitoring.uss_qualifier.configurations.configuration.ActionGeneratorSelectionCondition, as defined in monitoring/uss_qualifier/configurations/configuration.py

$ref.description: Path to content that replaces the $ref

potentially_generates_all_of.description: Only select action generators whose list_potential_actions result contains every listed action (using exact equality).  An empty list imposes no restriction.

potentially_generates_any_of.description: Only select action generators whose list_potential_actions result contains at least one listed action (using exact equality).  An empty list selects no action generators.

types.description: Only select action generators of the specified types.
